titleZh: 队友夺冠后，拉塞尔回应赛季起伏
title: Russell reflects on an uneven season after Antonelli's title
paragraphsZh: 安东内利在墨西哥站锁定年度冠军后，队友拉塞尔公开回应。他祝贺安东内利，也坦言自己本赛季受运气与发挥起伏影响。
拉塞尔表示将继续努力找回状态，并感谢车队。这是同队争冠后的个人回应，不改变已经确定的赛果。
paragraphsEn: After Antonelli secured the title in Mexico, Russell congratulated his team mate and acknowledged a difficult season shaped by inconsistent results and setbacks.
He thanked Mercedes and committed to recovering his performance. The response concerns his season rather than a change to the race classification.

titleZh: 安东内利凭墨西哥站季军锁定首冠
title: Mexico podium secures Antonelli's first championship
paragraphsZh: 安东内利在墨西哥站第三完赛，锁定个人首个 F1 年度冠军，并成为该项纪录的最年轻保持者。
公开赛报确认维斯塔潘赢得分站、汉密尔顿第二。安东内利不必赢下这场比赛，季军积分已足以确立年度优势。
paragraphsEn: Third place in Mexico secured Antonelli's first world championship and the youngest champion record.
The official race report lists Verstappen as the winner and Hamilton second. Antonelli did not need to win the Grand Prix; his podium result provided the points needed to settle the title.

titleZh: 汉密尔顿认为队内缠斗损害法拉利争胜机会
title: Hamilton says the Ferrari battle harmed its victory chances
paragraphsZh: 墨西哥站首圈，两位法拉利车手缠斗并冲出四号弯。勒克莱尔经草地取得领先，汉密尔顿损失动能，被维斯塔潘超越。
汉密尔顿最终第二，但认为队内竞争损害了车队争胜机会，主张通过内部沟通改善配合。
paragraphsEn: The Ferrari drivers ran wide at Turn 4 on the opening lap in Mexico. Leclerc crossed the grass into the lead, while Hamilton lost momentum and a position to Verstappen.
Hamilton finished second but believed the internal contest had hurt Ferrari's chance of winning. He called for discussions within the team.

titleZh: 勒克莱尔承认墨西哥站五秒处罚有依据
title: Leclerc accepts the basis for his Mexico time penalty
paragraphsZh: 勒克莱尔承认，在墨西哥站赛道外超越汉密尔顿后受到五秒处罚有依据。事发于首圈四号弯，两辆法拉利当时都冲出了赛道。
他没有立即交还位置。赛后分歧仍待车队沟通；汉密尔顿获第二，勒克莱尔在赛道上第四完赛。
paragraphsEn: Leclerc accepted the basis for a five-second penalty after passing Hamilton off the circuit at Turn 4 in Mexico. Both Ferrari cars had run wide.
He retained the position rather than immediately giving it back. Hamilton finished second and Leclerc crossed the line fourth; the disagreement remained a matter for internal discussion.

titleZh: 安东内利父亲谈夺冠背后的家庭支持
title: Antonelli's father discusses the support behind the title
paragraphsZh: 安东内利在墨西哥站第三完赛并锁定首个世界冠军后，与家人相拥庆祝。父亲马尔科把成绩与儿子从困难中积累经验的过程联系起来。
他强调家庭支持的重要性。这段采访补充了夺冠背后的家庭视角，而非新的比赛裁决。
paragraphsEn: Antonelli celebrated with his family after third place in Mexico secured his first championship. His father Marco linked the achievement to learning from difficult periods.
He emphasized the importance of family support. The interview provides a personal perspective on the title rather than a new sporting decision.

titleZh: 阿尔派两位车手赛后受罚，失去墨西哥站积分
title: Post-race penalties remove Alpine's Mexico points
paragraphsZh: 墨西哥站赛后，两位阿尔派车手因黄旗下减速不足受到处罚。科拉平托被加罚十秒，加斯利受到更重处罚，两人均失去积分区名次。
裁决改变了最终得分名单，哈贾尔和平川亮递补进入前十。核对积分时应使用修订后的分类。
paragraphsEn: Both Alpine drivers lost their points finishes in Mexico after penalties for insufficient slowing under yellow flags. Colapinto received ten seconds and Gasly a more severe sanction.
The decisions changed the scoring positions and promoted Hadjar and Hirakawa into the top ten. Points comparisons should use the revised classification.

titleZh: 凯迪拉克出售传闻：报道数字尚待独立核实
title: Cadillac sale report: financial claims await verification
paragraphsZh: 这条媒体标题称凯迪拉克车队出现财务亏损并寻求出售。本站尚无公司公告、财务文件或交易声明核实其中数字。
比赛积分属于竞技成绩，不能用于推算经营盈亏或出售估值。这些说法仍应作为待核实报道阅读，不能视为已完成的交易。
paragraphsEn: The indexed headline alleges financial losses and a possible sale of Cadillac's team. NOBI has no company announcement, accounts or transaction statement confirming those figures.
Championship points do not establish operating losses or a sale valuation. These remain unverified reported claims, not a confirmed transaction.
